sources.limits: 14 cameras at 9 Bloor W intersections between Yonge and Kipling, including 7 station intersections. Still images refreshed every few minutes, no video, no archive. Any counting from them must run on our side and store only counts, never frames of identifiable people.

sources.title: Bike Share Toronto station status (GBFS)
sources.limits: Point-in-time only. Trip history is published separately as monthly ridership files; add when needed.

sources.title: Bike Share Toronto ridership, trip-level monthly files
sources.publisher: Toronto Parking Authority via City of Toronto Open Data
sources.limits: Start and end station per trip, no route. Usage of corridor stations is a proxy for corridor cycling, not a measurement of it. Not yet parsed by the derive script.
